title: FSN Worldline and Holy Grail War Base Rules

formalWorldRules.name: FSN/FZ core sequence
formalWorldRules.summary: The pilot treats Fate/Zero's Fourth Holy Grail War and Fate/stay night's Fifth Holy Grail War as the core sequence for this p1-hybrid slice.

formalWorldRules.name: Holy Grail War foundational roles
formalWorldRules.summary: The Holy Grail War framework uses Masters, Servants, Command Spells, magic crests, and Grail-related conflict as foundational concepts.

formalWorldRules.name: Heroic Spirits become class-bound Servants
formalWorldRules.summary: Heroic Spirits become Servants through class summoning and magical supply; the Servant role is bounded by class and Holy Grail War framework.

formalWorldRules.name: Seven base Servant classes
formalWorldRules.summary: The core seven classes are Saber, Archer, Lancer, Rider, Caster, Assassin, and Berserker; class identity is separate from individual Heroic Spirit identity.

formalWorldRules.name: Command Spell authority
formalWorldRules.summary: Command Spells are a Master's limited authority over a Servant and can affect contracts, forced actions, and war-state changes.

formalWorldRules.name: Polluted Grail as route-level hazard
formalWorldRules.summary: Route summaries identify the Grail as polluted or tied to Angra Mainyu / all the world's evil, affecting Fate, UBW, and HF conflict resolution.

formalWorldRules.name: Third Magic and Heaven's Feel centrality
formalWorldRules.summary: Third Magic / Heaven's Feel is central to FSN, the Einzbern plan, and the Holy Grail system.

sandboxOrEngineRules.name: Sandbox day/night investigation and occult layer
sandboxOrEngineRules.summary: The sandbox source divides daytime public investigation from nighttime occult conflict.

sandboxOrEngineRules.name: Sandbox mystery scaling
sandboxOrEngineRules.summary: The sandbox source asserts Servants and Noble Phantasms dominate modern weapons and ordinary magecraft for engine balance.

sandboxOrEngineRules.name: RP output protocol
sandboxOrEngineRules.summary: The sandbox source defines story_driver, npc_driver, combat_driver, summary, and wlog output sections.

sandboxOrEngineRules.name: Sandbox date frame
sandboxOrEngineRules.summary: The sandbox source frames winter daily life from 1995 to 2004-01, Fifth Holy Grail War from 2004-02-02 onward, and sandbox mode after the war.

deferredToLaterWaves.reason: Locked plan assigns locations to wave-007. Wave-003 only references locations where needed for rule evidence.
Wave-003 records system-level Noble Phantasm and Command Spell rules; individual abilities remain for wave-008.
